## 2. TreeDataProvider vs WebviewViewProvider

**All sidebar features use `TreeDataProvider` / `createTreeView` / `registerTreeDataProvider`.**

**No `WebviewViewProvider`, no `"type": "webview"` views, no `registerWebviewViewProvider` anywhere.**

| Feature | Provider pattern | Registration |
|---|---|---|
| All Notebook Tags | `TreeDataProvider` | `createTreeView('all-notebook-tags-view', …)` |
| Jumpbacks | `TreeDataProvider` | `registerTreeDataProvider('jumpbacks', …)` |
| Custom NB Outline | `TreeDataProvider` | `createTreeView('custom-notebook-outline', …)` |
| Executed Cells | `TreeDataProvider` | `createTreeView('executed-cells-view', …)` (via cellExecution startup) |
| Git Modified Cells | `TreeDataProvider` | `createTreeView('git-modified-cells-view', …)` |
| Dependency Chain | `TreeDataProvider` | `registerTreeDataProvider('dependency-chain-view', …)` |
| Cell Tags (`cell-tag`) | **No TreeDataProvider in this repo** | Declared in package.json only; `cellTags.ts` uses `NotebookCellStatusBarItemProvider`, not a tree |
| Cell Metadata Display | **`WebviewPanel`** (editor panel, not sidebar) | `createWebviewPanel('cellMetadataDisplay', …)` |

---

## 3. “Only visible when active document is a Notebook”

Primary pattern: custom context key `jupyter-cell-tags.notebookActive`, set from `activeNotebookEditor`:

```86:92:C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\src\extension.ts
function updateContext() {
    const editor = vscode.window.activeNotebookEditor;
    vscode.commands.executeCommand('setContext', 'jupyter-cell-tags.notebookActive', !!editor);

    const textEditor = vscode.window.activeTextEditor;
    const isPlainTextEditor = !!textEditor && textEditor.document.uri.scheme !== 'vscode-notebook-cell';
    vscode.commands.executeCommand('setContext', 'jupyter-cell-tags.jumpbackTargetActive', !!editor || isPlainTextEditor);
```

Wired on `onDidChangeActiveNotebookEditor`, selection, and text-editor changes; most explorer views use `when: "… && jupyter-cell-tags.notebookActive"`.

Other visibility keys:

| Key | Set where | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `jupyter:showAllTagsExplorer` | `allNotebookTagsTreeDataProvider.ts` when active editor is `jupyter-notebook` | All Notebook Tags view |
| `jupyter:showTagsExplorer` | **Not set in this repo** (likely Jupyter / leftover) | `cell-tag` view |
| `jupyter.hasNativeNotebookOrInteractiveWindowOpen` | Jupyter extension | `cell-tag` view |
| `jupyter-cell-tags.jumpbackTargetActive` | `updateContext()` — notebook **or** plain text editor | Jumpbacks view (broader than notebook-only) |
| `config.jupyter-cell-tags.enableJumpbacks` | setting | Jumpbacks |
| `config.jupyter-cell-tags.customOutline.enabled` | setting | Custom outline |

Commands/toolbars often use VS Code’s built-in `notebookType == jupyter-notebook` instead of `notebookActive` (e.g. notebook filter toolbar buttons).

## notebookFilter module API (brief)

### `startup.ts` — `activateNotebookFilter(context) → NotebookFilterManager`
- Creates manager; registers `jupyter-cell-tags.notebookFilter.set` / `.clear`
- Set: QuickPick criteria → `manager.apply` → status message `Showing N/M cells`
- Clear: `manager.clear` on active notebook
- Debounced reapply (150ms) on notebook doc changes when filter active
- Syncs UI on active notebook change; `forget` on close

### `filterCriteria.ts`
- Type `NotebookFilterCriteria`: optional `tags[]`, `cellKind`, `hasOutputs`, `executed`
- Helpers: `isFilterActive`, `cellHasOutputs`, `cellIsExecuted`, `cellMatchesFilter` (tags OR; other fields AND), `summarizeCriteria`

### `filterQuickPick.ts` — `promptForFilterCriteria()`
- Multi-step QuickPick: tags (multi / skip) → kind → has outputs → executed
- Returns `undefined` on cancel or no constraints

### `NotebookFilterManager.ts`
- Per-notebook state map; status bar (`$(filter) match/total`, click clears)
- `apply`: expand matching inputs/outputs, collapse non-matches
- `clear` / `forget` / `reapply` / `syncUi`
- Sets context `jupyter-cell-tags.notebookFilter.active` for toolbar when clauses
